Workspaces

Shared network workspaces

AutoByteus NFS

Work on the same project folder from different computers. AutoByteus NFS runs independently of the app and keeps each node\u2019s settings, sign-ins and memories private.

Install and start on each participating computer

Run the command in a terminal on the computer you want to configure\u2014not inside an agent container. Copying a command does not execute it.

macOS

Native Mac storage; native and managed Docker agent clients.

Command not yet available

Linux

Native or Docker storage; native and managed Docker agent clients.

Command not yet available

No compatible, verified release is published for these computers yet. Command copying and downloads become available after release qualification.

Create storage once

Choose the ordinary folder you want to share. Existing files stay in place. Setup asks for the trusted computers or private subnet and explains any administrator or node-restart changes before applying them.

Connect each other computer

Choose Connect and use the storage connection details. Select only the local Docker nodes you want to attach; their image, ports, private volumes and sign-ins are preserved.

After setup verifies the connection, select a project beneath the printed workspace path. The default is /Volumes/autobyteus-shared on both macOS and Linux. An occupied path needs an explicit alternative; setup never hides its contents.

Use only on a trusted private network

NFS traffic is unencrypted. Access trusts the allowed computers, not individual users; writes map to the selected nonroot source owner. Connection details are not an access token. Do not expose this service to the public internet.

If storage or the network goes offline, file operations, previews and unrelated work may stall. Restore connectivity before retrying; there is no offline copy or local fallback.

Mac Docker storage hosting and Windows are not supported. On Mac, use native storage hosting; Docker agent clients are supported. The Docker Guide\u2019s local-only shared folder remains separate.
